name: Original Shady Sam one funded Lockpick purchase

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.2 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at original Sam')
 local sam=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0xc45b8));assert(sam and sam:isValid(),'Original Sam missing')
 print('SamFocus Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local inventory=Actor.inventory(self);local picks=0
 for _,item in ipairs(inventory:getAll(require('openmw.types').Lockpick)) do picks=picks+item.count end
 print('SamTrade Player lockpicks='..picks..' gold='..inventory:countOf('gold_001'))
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local center=sam:getBoundingBox().center;local delta=center-origin
 local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));if view:length()>2 or view:length()<.5 then return end
 local ax=math.atan2(view.y*delta.x-view.x*delta.y,view.x*delta.x+view.y*delta.y)
 local wanted=-math.atan2(delta.z,math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y));local ay=wanted-camera.getPitch()
 print(string.format('SamFocus aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor(ax*64+.5))),math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor(ay*128+.5)))))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 if ray.hitObject==sam and ray.hitPos and (ray.hitPos-origin):length()<tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')) then print('SamFocus ready') end
end}}}}
